title: HLabs: typescript cardano-node / ledger - cardano-ledger-ts and cbor multi ledger support

ms.promise:
The scope of the project is to maintain and upgrade the cardano-ledger-ts repository in order to be able to support all the Cardano Era.
With this milestone, we need to modify some functions in the code to allow the library to behave deterministically; in other words, it always behaves the same as the Haskell equivalent.
In order to do this, the main functions to be changed are the "fromCbor" and "toCbor" functions for each of the already present data types.
ms.criteria:
once a given CBOR (data) is given to a function modified in this milestone, the hash of that data is the exact same the we would have obtained if we used the Haskell implementation.
The only way that this is proven for a piece of code is via some tests, this is standard practice in the industry.
ms.report:
here is a video demonstrating that in the latest version of cardano-ledger-ts the "fromCbor" and "toCbor" method are now able to remember the original bytes, and are deterministic:

ms.promise:
The scope of the project is to maintain and upgrade the cardano-ledger-ts repository in order to be able to support all the Cardano Era.
With this milestone we extend support for data structures already defined for all eras starting from Byron
This implies transactions and all the other required fields according the the IntersectMBO/cardano-ledger cddl present in the various eras.
some of them are
・TxBody
・TxOut
・Address
・Value
・Metadata
・etc...

for a exhaustive list please see check IntersectMBO/cardano-ledger CDDL's
ms.report: Here is the video going through what as been achieved with this milestone: https://youtu.be/UzhnFyeWmbA

ms.promise:
extend support for data structures NOT already defined for all eras starting from Byron
This implies blocks and anything else not yet implemented according the the IntersectMBO/cardano-ledger cddl present in the various eras.
some of them are
・blocks
・headers
・block bodies
・etc...

for a exhaustive list please see check IntersectMBO/cardano-ledger CDDL's
ms.criteria:
the library will support all types defined in all eras cddl files of the `IntersectMBO/cardano-ledger` repository
the new types specified above will be implemented, for the seek of completeness, these include:
some of them are
・blocks
・headers
・block bodies
・etc...

This includes cbor serialization and deserialization.
after milestone completion ANY piece of data on the current Cardano blockchain will be recognized, implying it will be possible to take the raw bytes and construct and in-memory representation of the data stored on chain.
just like the previous milestone, but this time focusing

ms.promise:
What has been produced in the previous milestones will be used in practice in a prototype cardano-node implementation.
In other words:
The code produced so far will be used with some other code (already approved in other proposals) to do the work it is supposed to do.
In particular:
The data received from the network component (aka. blocks and transactions received from other nodes) will be validated using the code of this module.
Based on the necessities for the new prototype cardano-node, this module might receive some adjustments.
ms.criteria:
The code produced so far is used to verify the blocks received by the node.
The code will accept data that is correct, and reject data that is not correct.
Tests in the cardano-node will demonstrate this particular behaviour.
